changelog.notes: Legacy trial exported from ClimMob v2 records into release schema v2.0.

study.title: Bread wheat tricot trial in Mau, Ghazipur, Azamgarh (Uttar Pradesh), rabi 2013-14
study.description: On-farm tricot evaluation of bread wheat varieties in Mau, Ghazipur, Azamgarh (Uttar Pradesh), rabi 2013-14 season. Each participant ranked three varieties for several traits at the end of the season. ClimMob v2 export. Bread wheat trials in India were analysed in van Etten, J., de Sousa, K., Aguilar, A., et al. (2019). Crop variety management for climate adaptation supported by citizen science. PNAS 116(10), 4194-4199. https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.1813720116

location_privacy.method: Site coordinates rounded to two decimals (a cell of about 1.1 km), so the published point lies within 800 m of the recorded one and neighbouring sites share a point. Sites without coordinates take the mean of other sites in the same adm3 before rounding.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept, with spacing and capitalisation standardised

genotypes.maturity_abiotic_tolerance: Early sowing, resistant to high temperature at seedling stage

genotypes.biotic_resistance: Bold seed. Leaf & yellow rust resistance

genotypes.maturity_abiotic_tolerance: Double dwarf (98.2 cm) with medium early maturity
genotypes.biotic_resistance: Greater stability against all the three rusts and more especially against leaf rust and leaf blight
It carries different APR Lr13 gene that will act as buffer against leaf rust.
genotypes.remarks: It is a non IB/1R lines and therefore no sticky dough

genotypes.recommended_zone: Central (MP, Chhatishgarh, Gujrat, Kota & Udaipur divisions of Rajasthan)  and Penninsular (Maharastra and Karnataka) zones
genotypes.biotic_resistance: Adult plant resistance against brown and yellow rust

genotypes.recommended_zone: North Western and North Eastern Plain Zone
genotypes.biotic_resistance: It possesses very high adult plant resistance against most prevalent leaf rust disease as well as of 78S84 and 46S119 two most virulent races of yellow rust disease. It has also better degree of resistance against leaf blight
The variety possesses the usable and most practical type of disease resistance viz., the adult plant resistance (APR) because of Lr13
genotypes.remarks: Average seed yield is 35-40 q/ ha

genotypes.recommended_zone: late sown conditions of north eastern Plains Zone
genotypes.biotic_resistance: High resistance to stripe, stem and leaf rusts. It has seedling resistance to almost all the pathotypes of the three rusts; and adult plant resistance to virulent stripe rust. It has good levels of resistance to leaf blight, powdery mildew and foot rot
genotypes.remarks: HI 1563 is a good quality wheat genotype with good bread, chapatti and biscuit quality with good levels of micronutrients like iron, zinc and copper

genotypes.recommended_zone: Eastern U.P., Bihar, Jharkhand, Orissa, Sikkim, West Bengal, Assam and plains of NE states
genotypes.biotic_resistance: Resistant to leaf rust, Kernel bunt and tolerant to leaf blight.

genotypes.recommended_zone: North Eastern Plain Zone (Eastern Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, Orissa, Sikkim, West Bengal, Assam and Plains of far Eastern States)
genotypes.maturity_abiotic_tolerance: Early maturing and possesses terminal heat tolerance
genotypes.biotic_resistance: High level of resistance to leaf rust, stem rust and leaf blight

genotypes.recommended_zone: North Eastern Plain Zone (Eastern UP, Bihar, Jharkhand, West Bengal and plains of Assam)
Area stretching from Eastern UP onwards up to the Far eastern states viz., Bihar, Orissa, West Bengal, Assam & Plains of NE region.
genotypes.biotic_resistance: High degree of resistance to rusts and tolerance to leaf blight
genotypes.remarks: Possess desirable protein content with bold and hard grains, better chapatti making quality, good quality straw for cattle

genotypes.recommended_zone: Punjab, Haryana, Delhi, Western Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan(Except Kota and Udaipur Divisions), foothills of Himachal Pradesh, Jammu& Kashmir and Uttarakhand
genotypes.maturity_abiotic_tolerance: Heat tolerant, water stagnation tolerant and lodging tolerant
genotypes.biotic_resistance: tolerant to leaf blight, susceptible to brown rust

Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), rounded to two decimals to protect participants

Radius in metres around the published point that contains the original point (displacement plus spread of the sites used for gap filling)
Check of the original coordinate against the country boundary (ok, near_border, missing, outside, swapped_candidate, sign_flip_candidate)
First level administrative unit of the country (see metadata.admin_levels)
Second level administrative unit of the country
Name of the place below the lowest administrative level (village, community)
Planting date (YYYY-MM-DD)

Site identifier, links to site_data
Plot letter within the site (A, B, C)
Name of the genotype (variety) in the plot
Data collection moment (form) as named in the trial
Planned day of the collection moment, counted from the start of the trial as set in the trial design (the day of sowing in most designs); the same for every site. The actual date is moment_date
Day the form of the collection moment was filled in or submitted for the site (YYYY-MM-DD), the actual date of the observation; null when the source has none or the form was typed in after the season
Variable name, harmonised across trials

Question code or label as used in the trial
Value. For value_type rank, 1 is best and 3 is worst
rank, vs_local, numeric, date, categorical, multiple or text
